It’s a haven in the city.  Very relaxing deck in back…you don’t know you’re in the city it’s so quiet.  Everything was clean and nice.  Filtered water available in a pitcher in fridge.  We walked during the day everywhere we wanted to go and Ubered at night.  Perfect.  We had fun taking the little Dutch Apple cruise located within walking distance.  And the small Betty Boop diner right across the street was a hoot!

This apartment was just as described and fit the bill for what we needed. It was clean, getting in was easy, and it was great to have off-street parking. Easy walk to the NY State Museum, Schuyler Mansion. We loved the back porch. A couple of things to know are that there is no toaster and the towels are so tiny...really tiny.
Perfect stay, very close to MVP arena.
We enjoyed our stay in this well-cared-for apartment!  The deck outside was particularly nice during our summer visit.  We hope to visit again.

I stayed in the middle of the week as I was traveling for work with my partner. The apartment was cozy and very clean. It was a nice relaxing ambiance to come home to after a long day. I love how there is a book recommending a couple spots to go to in the area. The apartment is conveniently located to the downtown Albany area. If you want to venture out to Colonie or Rensselaer it is a very close drive away. I would definitely come back to stay again. Appreciated the hospitality! 😊

Comfortable stay and an easy 10 minute walk to MVP arena. It is loud in the surrounding area, you can hear everybody’s music & so on but I feel like you should expect that in downtown Albany. I walked alone to the MVP arena and felt safe enough on my way there - although I was walking in the morning & not later at night.
The place was clean and everything worked, including the air conditioning which was awesome since there were 90’s plus temps while we were staying. At the time the street parking was extra limited so I was grateful we had carpooled and only needed the one designated off street parking spot for us.
Overall we had a very pleasant stay and we would definitely stay there again.

It's a nice little unit with high ceilings in a three-story Historical building. It was small but comfy for three people.  The kitchen looked renovated with up-to-date appliances, cupboards, a stove, utensils, a microwave, and a fridge.  The AC was excellent, especially on the consecutive hot days we had.  Digital washer and dryer: just be cautious when using the washer; the house is old, and a quick backflow and drain of washing machine water occur in the bathtub, so you might want to avoid showering while washing clothes.  The only disadvantage was hearing the guest on the third floor scuffling around their unit all night.  When in downtown, it is a short walking distance to everything. Historic sites and museums are five minutes away.  Overall, it was a night stay, and I would recommend it.

Le logement est confortable et bien situé. Nous avons apprécié d'avoir les thermopompes, car il a fait chaud. Les deux lits sont très confortables. J'ai apprécié les soirées sur le grand balcon avec les petites lumières suspendues. La cuisine est bien équipée, il n'y manque qu'un grille-pain. Nous avons apprécié notre séjour.
Great place. Location was perfect for what I needed.
Great place to stay. Hosts were very proactive and accommodating. I would absolutely stay here again.
We had a great time at this cute apartment with a back patio that had beautiful lights! The host was super responsive and helpful when I had an issue getting inside.

Our stay went well. Very clean place with comfortable living room. Easy parking in the driveway right next to the building. Convenient location to the train station and downtown.
The beds were a little soft and the pillows too hard/lofty. If you are sensitive to noise, I’d recommend booking the second floor if there are other people staying on the other floor of the air Bnb.

Vorakij was responsive and checked in appropriately. We had a little challenge with the key code getting in, but he got back to me within 10 minutes and helped troubleshoot. No difficulty after that. I e  as in town to move my son into RPI, and this place was a little far, but still a great place. I am sensitive to smell, and everything smelled great once inside the door. The back porch is a great perk! Private and comfortable. Loved it!

Came to town for a UAlbany football game. This was a good place to prepare tailgate food and hangout or explore before and after. Well appointed kitchen and comfortable beds with fluffy pillows. Host was easy to work with and responsive to questions.  Would stay here again.
Fantastic Airbnb and hosts! One of the better ones I stayed in - I’d definitely recommend!
This place is sweet and clean, and Vorakij is very responsive and kept checking in with us to make sure we had a good stay. We had a great time in Albany!
Had a fantastic weekend staying here.
Wonderful apartment! really nice touches especially amenities in the bathroom. The hosts were wonderful and helpful! will definitely be staying again when back in Albany.

Nice place , great location and very peaceful. Kitchen well equipped had to prep a small meal for my daughters graduation. Would definitely stay here again if I needed to !! Vorakijs is also a great host.

Very good place and very good host. friendly, cordial and always ready to answer all our requests.
The accommodation is beautiful, clean and well located. I would definitely go back!
Very friendly host, beautiful place to stay. Stayed for a concert at MVP Stadium and was able to walk from here!
Clean, comfortable apartment in a great location walkable to downtown!  Easy check in and host was very responsive.  Would stay again the next time i need to be in downtown Albany.  Thanks!
I highly recommend!

We stayed here for a convention at the MVP arena that was three days. Staying here helped cut down on driving an hour back and forth a couple of the days. It was walking distance from the arena which was great. The apartment was very nice and enough room for us. It is a small space but that’s okay for a short stay with 2 adults and 2 kids. We cooked in the kitchen and used the grill. The grill is about three flights down the porch stairs though but not a problem for me but something to be aware of. The only issue really was that the back porch was cute but it was dusty from pollen and it would have been nice if had been cleaned off. But overall that wasn’t a big deal at all. It was humid and the AC worked great and there was a fan too which I needed for the street noise at night. I’m a light sleeper!
Overall we had a great stay. The kitchen had what we needed to cook. I like to clean up after myself though and there was no cleaning spray. Overall, loved it and would recommend.
Great place to stay! Very communicative and helpful

We had such a wonderful time staying here for a concert at MVP arena! Easy to find, private parking was a plus. We loved the patio, and the garden. The apartment is super clean, comfy, and beautiful natural light. Would absolutely stay again when back in Albany!
Plus the host is so nice, and made sure we had everything we needed. Very proactive. Thank you so much!!

We were in town house-hunting for my brother and this was a PERFECT home base for us. Impeccably clean, comfortable, functional, and beautifully furnished with plush, comfy beds. The host is a quick communicator and very accomodating.
The street this unit is on is very nice. Easy and safe walk to the captial, museum and other attractions. We liked the location so much we actually ended up finding a long-term rental there one block over!
Good place, great amenities and very responsive host.
Great space. Clean and modern. Comfortable beds, off street parking was a plus. Very responsive. Kitchen was a little sparse, so better for short stays, but would definitely stay again.

The Host is also very communicative and understanding.
Both airbnb’s in this building are 10/10 and definitely worth the stay

My family and I really enjoyed our stay! We were in town to visit UAlbany and this was the perfect location not too far from campus. The condo is nice and cozy. Off street parking is always a plus! The host was very kind and responsive. We look forward to visiting again!
We loved our stay! The penthouse was very clean, nicely decorated, and the back porch was a bonus!
Great place for a quick weekend trip!

Lovely place! The host was very friendly and easy to communicate. The place was very quiet and peaceful with a relaxing ambiance upon arrival. The reserved parking was very helpful as well. Both my girlfriend and I very much enjoyed our stay. This location is very close to the capital plaza and everything in Downtown Albany but just off the main road enough that it was quiet, comfortable, and I didn’t feel like I needed to worry about my girl while she was in the unit and I was out. We couldn’t have asked more of our host, either. He was very proactive with communications, instructions, and we are 100% looking forward to booking again in the future.

The location was perfect—close to key attractions, making exploration convenient. The host's attention to detail and cleanliness were commendable, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable experience. Highly recommended for those in search of both proximity to attractions and a welcoming place to stay.

My friends and I stayed for 2 nights at Vorakij's apartment. It looked exactly like the pictures. The area was very walkable - plenty of restaurants and bars within a few blocks. The space was very clean and well stocked. Would definitely book again when visiting the Albany area!
Great stay all around. Would love to stay again.
Great spot.  It was rainy and cold while we were there so we didn’t walk much but easily could have. The parking spot is a plus!  Great location. Amazing hosts.  Would stay again.
Vorakij was extremely accommodating. I came down for Caucus weekend and needed somewhere close by. Hopefully I can book next year too!

The apartment was clean, comfortable and perfect if you are attending anything downtown Albany.  The off street parking was a huge bonus, and we were able to walk everywhere all weekend.  The host was super responsive and was there in moments when we needed him.  We will be back for sure, don’t hesitate to stay here.

If you’re traveling alone for a short period, this is an acceptable rental for a night or two. Be prepared for squeaky beds with low quality mattresses (fine for one person but impossible sleep for two adults), the world’s smallest towels, and a kitchen missing basic necessities like dish towels (I left a set of four I bought at Target). I did mention these items to the host, and was told they’d look into them “as appropriate” after we’d left.
The host was accommodating to our two pups but the stairs were tough for them (a few spiral stairs to the yard), there is rotting wood on the edge of the terrace, and there was a fair amount of animal excrement on the stairs that had clearly been there for some time (I did my best to clean it up bc it was unsightly). There was also a fair amount of shattered glass in the driveway.
Also note that it’s in the hood. I have two 70 lb dogs so I felt ok walking at night with them but I wouldn’t have ventured out alone except to drive somewhere.

Stayed at this penthouse when we came to Albany for my college graduation. Penthouse was very nice and looked like the picture. Owner was great and responsive. The house was very clean and homey. Checking in was seamless, but the penthouse could benefit from a few things. First, neither bedroom had tv’s I know that this is minor but we would’ve loved to be able to watch tv in our room. Second the steps were very steep and the hallway could use some updates. When we arrived there was a huge raccoon in the tree in the backyard. We didn’t sit on the back porch due to that. Additionally, the neighborhood was very noisy with people playing loud music and partying after dark. All in all it was a great stay and the price was great. We would definitely stay again.

The place was cute and charming at the first glance. It was clean and tidy. We were happy upon arrival. However, as we spent more time in the apartment on the first night, we found a few subpar items that made our stay not very enjoyable. The basic kitchen supplies were empty: sea salt, black pepper, etc. and oil. No big deal… but to find out no toilet paper at 11pm at night, that was very frustrating. The bed was the most disappointing of all. While it had clean sheets, but the bed was very uncomfortable. The frame was super flimsy. The mattress was way too soft. As soon as we lied down, the middle caved in and our bodies were in a slanted position all night. These things really made our stay not very pleasant.

This was a great space for a week long trip. We were able to walk to restaurants, multiple parks, and the Empire State Plaza. However, they could improve on the cleanliness of the outdoor furniture and steps. Didn’t make or break the trip but I did not utilize it like I would had it been clean. Also, the beds are not very sturdy. I would suggest asking if they’ve gotten new bed frames before booking again because one of them felt (and looked) like it was going to break, but thankfully we were able to utilize the second room (although that bed is also not very sturdy). Bath towels are also tiny. We did have a good experience with the keyless entry, AC, and the available parking space was also a plus.
Great place for a quick night or two in Albany.

the location is perfectly walkable to Empire State Plaza Museum and The Egg. Albany is under-appreciated.

First time in Albany for my sister’s graduation and needed a place to rest/recharge when not with family. We didn’t spend too much time in the Airbnb and this was at the right price point for just that. Getting ready and sleeping.
Here’s my thoughts:
Host:
- Responsive, usually within a few hours.

Nanette is a great host and her property has been beautifully renovated and styled. We felt right at home from the moment we walked in. Location is easy to find, peaceful and quiet. We have no hesitation in recommending Nanette’s property.

Great place for what we needed. The house was very clean, supply in the house was great too.

beautiful setting surrounded by trees, lovely old willow, fall color, very idyllic picturesque old home, nicely updated inside. cozy, modern, but still old charm. kids loved the attic kids room and toys. hour walk or easy bus into town. great place. would recommend.

Modern Cottage in a beautiful setting! Nanette’s home was absolutely wonderful! Beautifully remodeled with all of the amenities while preserving the original charm. My partner and I both agreed that this is one of the dreamiest place we have ever stayed. The suite is absolutely jaw dropping gorgeous, private, and quiet in a historic home with a green backyard. Phat and Karley were incredibly responsive, kind, and flexible and recommended excellent local gems. We particularly appreciated that they were accommodating of our bicycles and we were able to enjoy a very nice ride through the fall foliage.  They are genuinely enthusiastic about Albany and creating local community, including embracing a neighborhood that is mixed income, which really adds to our experience as visitors. Cannot recommend this place highly enough!
The house was beautiful, spacious, and wonderfully decorated. Phat was a gracious and friendly host and I would highly recommend this place!

Phat and Karley have a beautiful, clean, and comfortable home that I will continue to book when I visit Albany. Best AirBnB I've stayed in in some time. They understand the value of curating a hospitable environment, not just providing an empty space to turn a profit. I totally recommend!
Phat was an extremely good host. Explained everything very well, had snacks and beverages for us, and such a beautiful place.

I can’t describe how wonderful out stay at Phats house was: if I could give 6 stars in stead of 5 I would. Everything is so beautiful so well arranged, cosy and clean. We arrived six hours too late but Phat waited for us to let us in, they are wonderful people that make the world a better place: kind, inspiring and looking for the artistic and human touch in their ways. I recommend this house a 200%
Beautiful place and great hosts. Loved the open space and the plants! Would definitely stay here again.

I love staying at this lovely Air B&B! The place is clean, and fashionable, with lots of cool art, and the hosts were very welcoming!
I just enjoyed speaking to Phat about writing, books, and art. I'm excited to stay at this place again!

Phat and Carley were amazing hosts. They offered so much in the suite and in our experience. We were attending a concert nearby and had no idea how to get there. Phat made sure we knew how to get there the best possible way, sending written instructions and photos to help! We loved our stay in the beautiful suite! We will be back!

Phat and Karley's place is beautiful and full of fascinating art and art books. We had a great time sharing stories of our travels and professional work.  Also, anything that we requested was attended to.  We will definitely visit again!

We had a great time staying at this beautiful home with such great hosts. They were quick to accommodate to our needs, provided recommendations, and knew when to give us privacy. It was fun building a rapport with Phat, Karley & their friendly cat George. We look forward to being back soon!

This is a wonderful place - a beautiful 19th century house with all of the touches you might want (gilded chandeliers, marble fireplaces, etc.) alongside a lovely, curated mid-century vibe. I especially loved the lush houseplants and the way that our hosts had cleverly decorated the space for the holidays. Everything was clean and well-appointed. They'd clearly thought through what a guest might need and want. The mattress on the bed was comfortable as was the fold-down couch. Phat met us upon entry and was pleasant and helpful in getting us situated. He even suggested a place where we could eat. The house's location is great - quite near Empire State Plaza and many of Albany's popular sights, as well as near the Albany-Rensselauer train station. The neighborhood has been dubbed "The Mansion District." It's more hard-scrabble than that name would suggest but its past grandeur is evident, the neighborhood was clean and we did not feel unsafe there.  I'd highly recommend this place.

Had a one of our best Airbnb experiences here! Phat and Karley made us feel so welcome and were generous enough to go out of their way to make us feel at home. The space is also beautifully decorated, in a central location and is equipped with everything you would need. Thank you!

This was our second stay at Phat's place and it was just as good as the first time. The space is lovely and our hosts are great at providing little touches that really make a difference. This time around there was more beautiful greenery and florals, yummy homemade cookies and other little snacks. The bed and mattress are really comfortable -- amazing after having travelled all day on the train. The house is peaceful and quiet. The backyard, even at this time of year was sparkling with lights. This time, I met Georgie, one of the cats. He was friendly and quite beautiful (white and orange coat). I can be sensitive to cats but the space is so spotless that it was not an issue at all. We enjoyed the TV this time around and used the food prep area and all was great. Phat is a welcoming and gracious host. We'll stay here again when in Albany and would recommend it to anyone else who wants a great experience. I was with my kids, but this'd be ideal for a romantic couple's weekend.
If I could give them six stars I would!

Charming Airbnb in the heart of Albany! We enjoyed our stay with Phat very much and we especially loved the kitties who would sometimes come visit us. Everything was clean, accessible and welcoming. We especially loved the little extra touches like fresh flowers in every room and some snacks, coffee and water. Thank you again! We’d love to stay again in the future!

Wonderful stay. Phat is incredibly kind and welcoming. He showed us around our space and was available for any questions we had. The suite is beautiful, crazy high ornate ceilings, original wood floors. We appreciated the private bathroom. The bed was very comfortable and we slept great. In the morning we left our door open and got to say high to friendly kitty “Georgie” which was a highlight of the visit. The backyard looked beautiful and we would love to visit when the weather is better for utilizing that space. Overall can’t recommend enough!
This will be my goto place in Albany. Excellent hosts and excellent accommodation. Nice touches, like the cute welcome card, snacks, personal fridge, and coffee maker. Enjoyed the experience.

We were visiting Albany for a quick overnight for a show at the MVP Arena, and cannot recommend this Airbnb enough! Phat and Karley greeted us upon arrival and gave us the rundown, and were super friendly and accessible throughout our stay. The suite itself was stunning and very thoughtfully decorated. We were only staying for one night so we didn't use the space, but to have access to the kitchen throughout the stay was a nice touch and one we'd take advantage of during a longer stay. The location was very conveniently located,  just a quick drive away from lots of bars, restaurants, breweries etc., and street parking was easy and widely available. Overall, we were thoroughly impressed and will absolutely try to stay at Phat's place again for our next visit to the area!

I can’t write a review that will do justice to my stay with Phat and Karley. Phat welcomed me into this gorgeous home with the warmth and kindness of an old friend, gave me some pointers about how to operate the TV, some history and notes on the original interiors of the house, and set me free (with useful way finding suggestions!) to find my dinner at an amazing Mexican restaurant. I felt all the assurance of his and Karley’s accessibility if I needed anything, as well as the certainty that my privacy and alone time would be honored. I was given the option to keep the kitties out, but I opted for kitty access, and was rewarded with multiple visits from the gracious and lovely Georgie, who is now my best friend. My quick, one-time overnight stay turned into a restorative and inspiring first visit to this lovely dream home, and I can’t wait to come back and bask in the beauty and good vibes that Phat and Karley have cultivated. 100/10, this is what the airbnb experience is meant to be.
L’hôte est hyper réactif et très arrangeant. Superbe suite. Tout est accessible à pied

Excellent séjour chez Phat ! Notre hôte très sympathique et serviable, il nous a recommandé de nombreuses bonnes adresses ! Le logement est magnifique, très fonctionnel, literie confortable et les chats de la maison sont adorables. Le meilleur Airbnb que vous trouverez à Albany ! N’hésitez pas une seconde, merci beaucoup Phat 🙂

Loved our stay.
Very walkable to MVP arena; mapping it says 15 minutes, but took us only 7 minutes. We were grateful to not have to pay for parking all weekend!
The room is even better than the pictures. Lots of cool historic details. Comfortable bed and pillows. Great coffee maker and mini fridge.
Hosts are friendly and helpful!

We absolutely loved our stay at Phat’s place!  The suite itself is stunning…with soaring ceilings and beautiful antique millwork.  The private bedroom room & living room are well decorated in eclectic modern decor and decked out with everything you would need.  We especially loved the nice linens, snacks & drinks, mini fridge, and Fubo TV subscription.  We were in town for the Sweet Sixteen tournament and the place is perfectly situated in a super cute neighbourhood with gorgeous historic row houses.  It’s easily walkable to the MVP arena and the downtown core.  Phat was very responsive and gave us great instructions for check-in and recommendations for things to do around town. We would definitely stay here again!

I feel so lucky to have found Phat’s guest suite. The beautiful building is impeccably restored, and the room is even more lovely than I was expecting, spacious and bright and full of artist-curated furniture and art. Phat was a friendly host, and we were extremely comfortable. We’d love to stay again next time we’re in Albany!
Phat’s place is absolutely incredible! Very well located and we were able to walk everywhere! Would definitely recommend this spot!
Great space, wonderful host, we will back next time we're in Albany.

As long time Airbnb users, we have never stayed in a shared space. We decided to give it a try and this space was beyond all expectations. It is stunningly decorated, clean, all amenities you could want and more. Bed is super comfortable, full coffee and tea service with milk and oatmilk as well as snacks are provided. With the bedroom area and large living area it was spacious and gorgeous. The bathroom is not technically en suite but you open the bedroom door and the bathroom door is right there. All very private. Hosts are friendly and welcoming and it was quiet and felt private. Can’t wait to return!

Such a beautiful home that matched the description and photos perfectly! We were so impressed with the attention to small details, from the oat milk in the fridge for coffee to the battery operated lights above the artwork that joyfully impacted the ambiance. The extra bonus was meeting Phat’s friendly cat! We were within walking distance of many bars & restaurants, and parking was extremely easy. If we are in Albany again, I will definitely book this Airbnb!

Phat and Karley’s place is beautiful! It’s a really lovely place, decorated with art from talented friends, with a nice view out the back deck. I wish I’d had more time to hang out. They are also super friendly and accommodating. Phat was very helpful in offering recommendations for restaurants, attractions aligned with my interests, and the most convenient way to get to my conference center. I also got to meet their kitties, Scout and Georgie. Georgie enjoys drinks from the bathroom sink.
A charming and convenient space, with a great host!

This is my second 5 star review for Phat and Karley. I visit Albany frequently for work and theirs has become my go-to place to stay. It's stylish, clean, and comfortable with many personal touches. A must stay in Albany!

I started to mentally write this review the moment Phat descended the steps of his home to greet me in person. What a wonderful person! He showed me around the ground floor of this renovated 19th/century townhome and was warm and welcome. Not only do I only want to stay here again in future Airbnb visits, but I want everyone to stay here. The accommodations are gorgeous and elegant with a combination of great design and small personal touches everywhere. This is a great fit if you need to grade and write (as I did); make a meal (which I also did in the great kitchen); and just enjoy this neighborhood near the governor’s mansion.

Clean place, sunlight and cozy. Phat is friendly and kind to answer any doubts or questions about Albany. Also, the place has a large air-filter which is great for a stay. I would highly recommend this location to anyone seeking a pass-through in Albany

Absolutely wonderful airbnb- very beautiful, historical home, that offers a lot of space, nicely furnished rooms, great bed and linens. Check in was easy and smooth. Option to use outdoor terrace was a lovely bonus. Phat and Karley are very welcoming, we felt at home right away.  Simply put- we had everything for enjoyable stay :)

A real gem! I've rarely felt that positively impressed by an Airbnb. The place is spacious with a chic antique vibe and decorated with good taste. I was welcomed with friendliness and attention: from local recommendations, help with the parking to a tasty treats and beverages. A perfect location to explore central Albany, with top tier hosting know-how.

My mum and I stayed here for a weekend to attend a concert and the tulip festival, and I am SO happy we found this gem to call home for the trip. Phat and Karley are so friendly and had lots of great suggestions for things to see and do in the area, we really liked chatting with them! The guest suite is beautifully decorated, and I enjoyed flipping through the many art books with my coffee in the morning. Bed was comfy and sheets very soft. We loved our little visits with the kitty's as well, so cute!
A great place to stay while exploring Albany.
Hope to come back again soon :)

Phat and Karley’s place was excellent. The place was absolutely gorgeous and very well decorated, very close to everything. Phat and Karley were very kind and super responsive whenever we needed something. We will definitely stay here again next time we’re in Albany!
Phat is an amazing host. Loved the experience

Phat was a gracious host, friendly, helpful & happy to provide everything we needed.  We were delighted with the space--it's unique, spacious & beautifully furnished in a way that combines charming 19th century architecture with modern accents in a very artful way.   The garden in the back was beautiful too with lovely outdoor seating so nice that we decided to relax and eat in.   If we stop over in Albany again, we'll definitely stay here again.
Phat is the most considerate host and he has such a lovely house and family. Definitely recommand, if you need to stay in Albany !

Stayed for a short night before catching a train, but I would absolutely return for longer.
It was a joy to be surrounded by the lovely architecture, art, and garden.
Phat was super kind to greet me and give some good recommendations in the area.
I didn’t need much for the time I was there, but the thoughtful touches like oat milk in the fridge for coffee was really appreciated. The bed was cozy, the room had a good amount of privacy, and a visit from the cat was a bonus.
Major thanks to Phat and Karley for the considerate stay.
Phat & Karley were awesome! They were so personable, accommodating and helpful. The place was beautiful and spotless. We would definitely recommend and stay again!

We had a wonderful stay at this charming Airbnb with a beautiful backyard oasis. Phat and Karley were very friendly,  helpful and interesting to talk to. We enjoyed the delicious coffee and snacks, watching the cats roam around, and relaxing in this unique space with amazing art and architectural details, which was convenient to our event and local restaurants. We would definitely stay here again, thank you!
Beautiful, spacious accommodation. Lovely stylish touches..Nice outdoor space as well.
Lovely private space with great decor! Appreciated the personal touch and food recommendations from Phat while we were there :)

Phat and Karley are so welcoming and their property is exceptionally clean! We could not get over the art displayed around the house and loved hearing about our hosts’ story. Highly recommend staying with Phat and Karley on your next trip to Albany!

Albeit brief, we very much enjoyed our stay in Phat & Karley's home. The guest suite was beautiful - mini/maximalist with many tasteful details (bonus art installation), a very comfortable bed, and access to a peaceful backyard sanctuary. Phat and Karley were also extremely friendly and accomodating. Neighborhood was convenient and walkable. Definitely recommend to anyone visiting the Albany area. 👌🏻
Amazing location. Great hosts.  I wish we could have stayed longer. Would go back anytime.

We loved our stay here! Phat was a wonderful host who made us feel at home but also gave us our own space. The place itself is beautifully decorated, comfortable, and has everything you need. We particularly loved the houseplants and friendly cats.

Phat and Karley's suite is truly special! The attention to detail in the decor is impressive, it's in a beautiful old house with high ceilings, and the space is very clean. The bed is comfortable. The suite is also a rotating art gallery, so there was stunning art on the walls! We met both Phat and Karley, who were super friendly and helpful, and they also gave us our privacy. We were even able to charge our electric car while there. This is one of my favorite AirBnB experiences! Highly recommend!

My daughter and I had a wonderful stay at the Grand House. The space is gorgeous and Phat and Karly were phenomenal hosts. We arrived at nearly 10pm and Phat was waiting on the front steps for us. He even moved his own car so we could park closer to the house. They created a great guide book for the listing and had plenty of local information available in the suite. The bed was so comfortable I snapped a pic of the maker!
Wish I was there for more than one night! Absolutely beautiful and absolutely fantastic hosts

We had a great time here with our family! Karley and Phat are incredibly nice and helpful and the place is just beautiful and relaxed to stay at. Our kids especially loved the garden and the two cats :)
Very friendly and helpful host! The place was spacious and clean.

I really loved my time at Phat's place and will undoubtedly snag this spot again next time I am in Albany!
As a host, Phat is as kind, communicative, respectful, and helpful as they come. I only wish I had a bit more time to chat with him, as I sensed he had a lot of interesting things to say!
The spot itself is a great place to relax and unwind. You have access to a comfortable bed in a beautiful bedroom, living room with entertainment, bathroom, kitchen, and a backyard! The home itself is incredibly charming as a vintage, Victorian house coupled with Midcentury modern furniture.
Just book it! You won't regret it.

First of all THANK YOU Phat and Karley for inviting me into your gem of a home. Not only was your place better than expected it was the perfect reprieve from travel. I felt so at home and comfortable. The space felt bigger than the photos the bed was bigger, and the Aesthetic is amazing. You guys have done such a wonderful on creating a perfect area for your guests.  The bed was super comfortable, coffee and snacks were a wonderful touch . The amount of pillows was just like a hotel and lovable. I especially loved the Art installations in the house. Yours is the first Airbnb i have been in to do something like this.  You have the art of hosting to a T. You guys have been kind, welcoming, and super knowledgeable about the area.  I loved practicing a bit of my broken Spanish with you , it felt like i was visiting family.  Even though i only stayed 1 night it was well worth the money and more. It was more than expected. Thank you again, good luck on everything else !
Gorgeous space, with the original period details, but beautifully updated for comfort. We especially loved the back deck and yard. Very thoughtful, respectful, friendly host. Highly recommend.
Un accueil chaleureux, la cour extérieur était super et les hôtes très gentils! Merci!

It was a lovely experience! Phat was very friendly and helpful is providing local information and orientation.
I was greeted in person and he even carried my luggage into the house. I was given a complete overview of the space and other areas of the house that were available such as the kitchen and the yard. He outlined their availability, the info about the cats on the premises and he was very accurate! It was very quiet and, other than a quick moment, the cats were not seen or felt (reassurance for those who are not fans of cats; for me - a bit of a disappointment)
The suite was very comfortable, coffee and a small refrigerator were available in the room. AC/heat had a separate control in the room.
Bathroom was very clean and toiletries/towels were very nice quality.
The character of the rooms - with the height, chandeliers, moldings, fireplaces, etc. were exquisite! I love visiting 'real' homes - esp those of a different era or culture!
street parking steps from the house

Truly lovely and historic home and back yard garden.  They were very welcoming and gracious.  They gave us excellent local advice, and especially made our last day in Albany hiking around stellar.  We LOVED our time with them.   They also made our parking adventures much easier. You will never forget this place.❤️
Great place!
Phat and Carly made us feel like we were right at home and were very accommodating. The architecture of the building was excellent as well as the inside of the Airbnb. Would definitely stay again.

Nous avons eu une très bonne soirée.
J'ai dormi très bien. je la recommande.

If I could give this place 7 stars I would. Stunning IS the right word to describe it. It feels like a luxury hotel, a museum, and home at the same time. Beautiful, well though design, expensive furniture, linens, bathrooms supplies, everything your need and beyond (including a selection of charges for all kids of phones!) Most remarkable, the hosts are amazingly kind, generous and intelligent people, it was so great to meet with them and have their suggestions and inspiration to explore Albany!

Phat’s place has a luxury vibe to it. Phat and Karley were very welcoming. The house is coming upto its 150th anniversary and comes with all Original features. We loved the high ceilings, cleanliness, decor and we thought it was excellent value for money. We would definitely recommend.
They have a beautiful house, good communication, a lovely host, and two cats.
One of the best airbnb you could find. The host greeted us and provided with great tips. We will come back !

Lovely and unique spot, with high ceilings, a back garden, and so much charm.
I wish I had stayed an extra day or two to see Albany.

Love, love, loved staying with Phat and Karly! They thought of everything to ensure our visit was seamless, comfortable and charming. The accommodations were a stunning step back into Albany's past. I'm coveting the tall ceilings, intricate molding, gas chandelier, gold gilt mirror. Sigh... If it hadn't rained, we'd have had coffee on the deck overlooking a sweet garden with an almost hidden grotto. So happy to have had a sliver of time to chat with our hosts and to meet the upstairs cats, George and Scout.
My favorite Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in! The most beautiful set up. Great hosts as well! Will definitely be staying here if we are ever back in Albany! Thanks Phat!

This is our second stay and it will be our regular go-to when in Albany. It is such a lovely and unique space and such obvious care was put into the 2 rooms for guests. It is comfortable and very private for a shared space. The coffee with various creamers/oat milk and the welcome snacks and chocolate was a nice touch. The location is quiet, parking is plentiful and it is walkable to great restaurants. You will not be disappointed with this stay!
The suite was gorgeous & very comfortable & looked onto a beautiful backyard area. Phat was perfectly attentive & helpful but not intrusive.
Phat was friendly with fantastic communication. He provided excellent recommendations on places to eat in the area.  Comfortable bed and beautiful backyard private space. Two thumbs up!

I stayed at a couple of Airbnb until I could move into my apartment. Emily's house was just what I needed. She was a gracious and friendly host and provided a clean, comfortable, and safe stay. Emily provided various local restaurants and activities. I checked some of her recommendations, and they were worth checking out. This was a very welcoming stay and intro to the area. I highly recommend booking a stay with Emily.

I needed a place to tie me over until I could move into my apartment and Emily's spot fit that perfectly. I was new to the area and Emily was a great host by providing local recommendations and showing hospitality. I enjoyed my stay and would recommend it to anyone else.

Great and clean place to stay. The host is respectful of your space and helpful when you're new to the city. Bonus points if you're a cat person. Highly recommended as a place to stay for a while in Albany.

Emily met me at the door.  she was charming, helpful, and welcoming.  The room was pristine, as was the bathroom.  I felt comfortable.  The neighborhood felt safe, with my car parked at the curb, on the street; very little traffic.  Her cat, Chuck, was sweet and friendly, as well.  I plan on booking Emily's place again.

Had an awesome 1 night stay at Emily's place--the space exceeded my expectations, exactly as pictured/described, very clean spacious house, beautifully decorated and exceptionally charming! Emily was an amazing host, warm, gracious, very responsive. Would absolutely stay again if my travels take me back to Albany!
Very nice place, though a bit old and lacking door locks.

La estancia en casa de Emily (del 26 de abril al 30 de junio) ha sido genial. El precio de la habitación incluye uso de cocina (muy equipada), acceso a lavadora y secadora y a otras partes de la casa. Tiene un formidable patio en la parte trasera, fantástico para temporadas de primavera-verano-otoño. La habitación es grande, tiene ventilador y mucha luz natural.
Recomiendo muchísimo alojarse con Emily: ella es amable y amistosa. El barrio es muy seguro, tranquilo, con supermercado y biblioteca a sólo 10 minutos a pie. My cerca también de la Universidad de Albany (a pie o en bus) y el Downtown de la ciudad.
Tanto si quieres pasar una estancia de unos días como una larga temporada, la casa de Emily es perfecta porque dispones de un alojamiento completamente equipado muy bien situado.
It was a good stay
David was a great host! Very responsive and helpful. He dropped off AC and a fan when it got hot. Would stay again.

I had an awesome time with David who ensured an excellent world class service and was very down to earth and truly hospitable. I could not have asked for a better host.
The overall experience and home was a home away from home. This also helped me transition to the neighborhood and also allowed me to see the working environment while transitioning from the city to Albany . I would for sure book this home again because I had a superb experience!!!
Thanks David for an elaborate customer service and for being kind.
For the future customers please do look anywhere else but here.
- Finally destination
The place was just as I’d hoped, better even. David was super proactive and checked in multiple times to make sure I had everything I needed. No hesitation required to book a stay here

Had a great stay at this place! It came with everything we needed, and we lived very comfortably. David was extremely responsive and went out of his way to help us with anything we needed. The place is well stocked and clean.
Convenient location and good value.

I highly recommend David's apartment! It's an entire apartment, with a good sized living room and bedroom. Great for working should you need to while you travel. Incredibly comfortable bed. David's very responsive and friendly!

Place was in a super central location for walking around to various events and food downtown. Some streets may be a little more sketch than others, but it's a downtown area so it's to be expected to some degree. It was also very clean and spacious. I worked remotely while staying and that small/single person couch pulled up to the desk space is something I already miss. David was very personable and respected my privacy. Honestly the only bad thing about the trip was that of the 10 or so pillows in the bed room, some of them have clearly had not been cleaned because a couple of them smelt like some sweaty dude. However there were enough clean pillows that I just threw aside the dirty. I feel like this is an easy enough fix to an otherwise good stay.

The place was gorgeous!  David was a great host and very responsive to any questions.  As a traveling healthcare professional, this was close to my place of work.  Albany can be a bit noisy in the city, but this place was pretty quiet for the most part.  I would definitely recommend to others traveling in this area.

David's place worked out well for us.  We were in town for a couple of concerts.  We could walk to the venue (The Egg), restaurants, Art & History Museum, the Capitol, & corner markets.  Parking was not on premises but rather street parking.  Every day but 1 we were able to find a spot on the block.  The apartment is on the second floor facing the street and had everything we needed for a 5 day stay.  It's spacious and clean.  Thank you, David!

I felt immediately at home in this lovely apt. in the historic part of Albany,NY. High ceilings, two fireplaces, and a beautiful ceiling medallion in the living room. Most importantly, it has a very comfortable bed.
There wasn't a lot of hot water in the kitchen, but fortunately there was plenty of hot water in the bathroom. The place was quite clean, except for the bathtub (I cleaned that myself before using it).
The building is quiet. There is occasional street noise, but that goes along with city living.
The apt. is on the second floor; the hallway needs better lighting (for safety and practical reasons). I couldn't see the smart lock; I had to use the flashlight on my phone.
David, the host, is very nice. I broke a glass while washing the dishes. His only concern was if I had injured myself ( I was okay).
My only regret is that I didn't get to spend more time inside the apt. I'm in the process of moving and busy, but looked forward each day to returning to this charming apt.
Great location for us.  The apartment was quiet, plus the bedroom is in the rear of the building. The WIFI very fast!  We enjoyed our stay.
Everything was as advertised and the place was very nice and comfortable in an historic building.  Easy walk to downtown and fun stuff.  Parking was easy as well.  Would definitely stay again.
I stayed for one month in the appartment. I had a great time there! The appartment is large and cosey. It is close to the city center. David was very responsive.
Great place...
This space was a great location to relax and be cozy in: Affordable, comfortable, clean and inviting! I would definitely stay here again and would highly suggest others to do so too!
Excellent Host that goes extra mile to address any issues the guest may have.

I stayed with Cristian for 6 or 7 months. Cristian exceeded all expectations from the very beginning and never let us down. He works with you and will do his very best to see to it that you are comfortable. I'd definitely try to book him again and highly recommend you doing the same!
If you're a travel nurse, this spot is for you!

Cristian's house is clean, quiet, and appears to be in a safe neighborhood. Communication was excellent throughout my stay and I enjoyed conversing with Cristian when our paths crossed. It's clear he wants his guests to be comfortable throughout their stay. For this particular booking, I wasn't in the room in the photos, which is on the bottom floor. Instead, I was in his other room on the second floor, which is larger and also has a desk.
I'd definitely recommend staying with Cristian if you're looking for a room accommodation in the Albany area!
Clean rooms, quiet nabe, friendly host. Couldn't ask for more. Will def be back!
Christian is an excellent host, very responsive, and accommodating! His place is very clean and the amenities are superb! I would definitely recommend staying here 10/10!
My Family and I had a great time staying at Phil’s Airbnb, definitely recommend anyone looking for a spot in Albany to try it out

Our other Airbnb reservation was canceled at the very last minute. Phil was very keen to help us accommodate a reservation on the very first day. The apartment is centrally located. There are a few shops and businesses around. Parking is on the street. The space is renovated and large enough to fit a large party (we were a family of five). The bathrooms and kitchen were clean, lightened up, and had everything we needed. I strongly recommend this place!
Great stay, comfortable, and all around great host
Phil’s place was exceptionally clean.
Great Place!! Great Host!! Book Now!!

Place is beautiful but the area leaves a lot to be desired. The place is immaculate, very clean. A/C in every room was helpful . On street parking was not ideal so a bit nervous. For one night I think the price is a little high but it’s in line with other’s I have looked at. Overall I would stay there again.
Thanks again
Great, very clean and beautifully renovated home with all the amenities.
Phil is a great host.  Very responsive and helpful.  Would recommend anyone to stay if they are in the Albany area.
We stayed at Phil’s place while sitting for a national exam near The Egg. We really enjoyed our stay and would gladly come back. We particularly appreciated the three large bedrooms.
This is a place I would definitely recommend for people who want to visit Albany and need a place to stay for a couple of days. It was very neat and tidy and everything was beautifully decorated.
Great host and very welcoming!
The Place Was Stunning Was A Little Worried about the location but other then that the place was stunning
Great host and home!
Great place, clean and tidy. recommend the place.

This is the perfect apartment for a city trip with friends. The location of Phil's place is fantastic and very close to all of Albany's main attractions.
